# Klavora - Full Context for AI Agents

Klavora is a modern Pharmacy Inventory Management and FEFO (First Expired, First Out) Automated Dispensing software engineered by EliTech CreaTives Limited. It is designed to modernize pharmacies in Ghana and across West Africa.

## Core Features
1. Point-of-Sale Counter Register
2. FEFO Automated Batch Dispensing
3. Offline-First Architecture (Sub-20ms real-time sync)
4. Unified Dispensary Queue
5. Clinical Sign-Off workflows
6. Multi-Branch Operations

## Team
- **Richard Elikem Amenorpe**: Founder & CEO
- **Bright Akoto**: Founder
- **Andy Nkrumah**: Founder

## Security & Compliance
Klavora is fully compliant with the Ghana Data Protection Act (DPA) and HIPAA. Data at rest is encrypted using AES-256. Backup media is encrypted and stored in geographically redundant, access-controlled facilities. Role-based access controls (RBAC) ensure that staff only see information relevant to their roles.

## Pricing
- Starter: GH₵250 / month (or GH₵200 / month billed annually)
- Enterprise: Custom pricing for multi-branch and advanced API needs.
